annotations.text:
Three structures, same tokens. Pick one, or point at what to mix.
A: the action sits where the thumb is; templates are a list; the gym is a quiet row.
B: a week strip and last workout first — needs two NEW strings ("3 workouts · last Tue"), your call.
C: action first at the top; templates as a grid; the gym moves into the nav bar.
Live workout: Resume takes the amber; Start Empty Workout steps down to a grey button. Same rule in B and C.
